name: The Gallerist

categories.label: Money before final scoring
categories.labelVi: Tiền trước khi chấm điểm cuối
categories.hint: Money (cash) on hand when the game ends, before final scoring.

categories.label: International Market majorities
categories.labelVi: Đa số Thị trường quốc tế
categories.hint: Total money from the 3 market columns (top rows incl. auction assistants): most/2nd/3rd get the amounts printed per column (left column 6/3/1); ties add tied positions and split, rounded down.

categories.label: Auctioned Renowned Work of Art
categories.hint: Sales value of the Renowned Work you won, as if by the most famous discovered Artist of that art form.

categories.label: Curator card collections
categories.hint: Money for completed collections on your Curator card from exhibited works (max 4 exhibited incl. a Masterpiece, plus 1 auctioned work).

categories.label: Reputation tiles (money)
categories.hint: Money from each Reputation tile on your board; any Influence they grant is scored on the Influence track.

categories.label: Exhibited works (sales value)
categories.hint: Sum of the sales value of each Work of Art currently exhibited in your Gallery.

categories.label: Art Dealer card sets
categories.hint: Money for completed sets of sold Works of Art on your Art Dealer card.

categories.label: Influence track money
categories.hint: Money based on your position on the Influence track at game end.

categories.label: Works of Art acquired (tiebreak)
categories.labelVi: Số tác phẩm đã có (phân định hòa)
categories.hint: Tiebreak 1: most Works acquired (exhibited and sold).

categories.label: Visitors in Gallery (tiebreak)
categories.hint: Tiebreak 2: most Visitors in your Gallery.

categories.label: Assistants in play (tiebreak)
categories.labelVi: Trợ lý đang chơi (phân định hòa)

tiebreakers.description: Most Works of Art acquired (exhibited and sold)
If still tied, all tied players win

notes: family: point-salad-euro (money-as-VP). Winner = most money after final scoring; all scoring is in money. Final scoring order: market majorities, auction of Renowned works, Reputation tiles, exhibition, Curator cards, Art Dealer cards, Influence. Column payouts of the middle/right market columns and Influence money values are printed on the board, so they are scorer inputs. Rulebook wording differs slightly between sources on exhibited-work limit (4 exhibited + 1 auctioned in the English rulebook). Scoring Expansion only changes intermediate scoring. Solo (Lacerda) scored the same way.
